forbidden_inputs: historical territorial maps or their thumbnails
boundary vectors, rasters, control labels or coordinates derived from held-out maps
unlicensed monument imagery or map extracts
geometry_role_rule: A feature geometry proves location only. Allocation, friction, attraction, exclusion or alignment requires a separate supported claim and scenario decision.
output_gate: No boundary-hypotheses geometry may be produced until preregistration reconstruction_gate is met and reconstruction_ready becomes true in a reviewed commit.

allowed_sources: redistributable modern coastline or administrative-free land data
OS Terrain 50 under OGL or another documented redistributable DEM
required_layers.historical_role: modern physical surface; cost meaning requires declared model assumption

allowed_sources: GeoNames CC BY 4.0 plus reviewed historical place identification
required_layers.historical_role: coordinates only until a control claim is admitted

allowed_sources: OGL monument records or permission-cleared archaeological data
required_layers.historical_role: display context by default; no political-boundary equivalence

allowed_sources: redistributable modern data plus text-supported historical route relations
required_layers.historical_role: location only until a traversal or corridor claim is admitted
